description: Données supplémentaires pour un document sur les politiques de l’industrie chinoise des équipements maritimes is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Vrije Universiteit Brussel. Supplementary Data for a paper detailing China’s Maritime Equipment Industry Policies. It has been accepted for publication and is currently undergoing the editorial process. The paper is a part of the author's PhD at the Vrije Universiteit Brusels, which centers around the People Republic of China's build-up of maritime power in the economic domain. Coverage: Vrije Universiteit Brussel. The portal shows the English title as "Supplementary Data for a Paper on China’s Maritime Equipment Industry Policies" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Vrije Universiteit Brussel. Its keywords include maritime equipment industry, China, European Union, strategic trade theory, IDDS. The listing shows 6 download or service links in TSV, CSV. The listing shows 2024-03-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
